{"id":1941381504,"question_id":4220,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"4 months, 2 weeks","timestamp":1772938636,"status":11,"status_display":"Wrong Answer","runtime":"N/A","url":"/submissions/detail/1941381504/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Minimum Operations to Sort a String","memory":"N/A","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int minOperations(string s) {\n        int n =s.size();\n        string t = s;\n        sort(t.begin() , t.end());\n\n        if(s == t) return 0;\n        if(s.size() == 2) return -1;\n\n        char mini = 'z';\n        int oprs = 0;\n        for(int i = n-1 ; i>=0 ; i--){\n            mini = min(mini , s[i]);\n            if(s[i] > mini)  oprs++;\n        }\n        return oprs;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"minimum-operations-to-sort-a-string","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1805}
